bundle.shortDescription: Your local PDF and EPUB library on a 3D bookcase
bundle.longDescription: Shelfs keeps your PDF and EPUB files on your own disk and draws them as books on a wooden bookcase. It reads them, remembers where you stopped, and never touches the files themselves.
